name: Mauling Bear
text: The first time each round you trump, you win that trick.

signature.trigger: you trump for the first time each round

decision: When to make the first trump: with a low spade, saving your high ones, since nothing can overtrump it.
opponent: Visible when it resolves; opponents learn to trump in before you or to save their spades for later tricks.
aiNote: Make your first trump with your lowest spade.
rationale: Overtrumps are Spade Master's main threat, and this answers one a round without touching the opponents' cards: the first trump wins with any spade, about half a trick a round when an overtrump was coming, and a low spade is enough.
deviation: Redesigned from converting an opponent's highest spade, which was hard to understand and unpleasant to play against.
